4th Period.smartGoal: I can make my first commit so that my changes are saved to my GitHub repository.
4th Period.contentStandard: CA CS Standards 6-8.CD.1 — Recommend improvements to existing code using peer review processes.
4th Period.eldStandard: ELD.PI.6-8.1 — Exchanging information and ideas with others through collaborative discussions.
agenda: Demo: Commit & push on the DocCam (10 min)
Guided Practice: Make your first commit
Exit Ticket: Link to your commit
4th Period.connections: Yesterday we created our repositories. Today we save real changes to them. Tomorrow we start building our portfolio pages.

6th Period.smartGoal: I can identify patterns in code so that I can predict what a program will do.
6th Period.contentStandard: CA CS Standards 6-8.AP.10 — Use flowcharts and/or pseudocode to design solutions to complex problems.
6th Period.eldStandard: ELD.PI.6-8.6 — Reading closely and explaining orally how an author uses language to support ideas.
agenda: Direct Instruction: Reading code patterns (10 min)
Exit Ticket: Explain one pattern you used
6th Period.connections: Yesterday we found patterns in everyday life. Today we find them inside real code. This sets up next week's intro to Code.org.

7th Period.smartGoal: I can log in to my Chromebook and Google Classroom so that I'm ready to learn every day.
7th Period.contentStandard: CA CS Standards 6-8.IC.1 — Compare tradeoffs associated with computing technologies.
7th Period.eldStandard: ELD.PI.6-8.1 — Exchanging information and ideas with others through collaborative discussions.
agenda: Demo: Logging in & finding the Stream (10 min)
Guided Practice: Submit the tech use agreement
Exit Ticket: Where do you find today's agenda?
7th Period.connections: This builds directly on yesterday's Treatment Agreement — today we make sure everyone can actually access our classroom tools.
